widgets_values:
This is a vertical Mid-Autumn Festival promotional poster with a warm, cinematic night setting dominated by deep blues, smoky grays, soft moonlight, and gold accents. In the upper-left portion, delicate cherry blossom branches extend inward from the edge, their dark twigs carrying dense clusters of pale pink blossoms with yellow centers and green undertones. Behind them is a starry midnight-blue sky transitioning into hazy sunset clouds near the horizon. Large cream-colored Chinese brush-calligraphy forms the main headline "中秋" across the upper-left quadrant, rendered in thick textured strokes resembling dry ink or sand paint, with expressive splatters and uneven feathered edges. Below and partly integrated into the same brush-art composition is the secondary phrase "快乐", written horizontally in the same hand-painted off-white stroke texture and partially surrounded by drifting white petal-like decorations and leaf silhouettes. Beneath the main headline sits a refined subtitle lockup framed by thin horizontal orange-brown divider lines and small filled dot ornaments: the English festival text ". MID AUTUMN FESTIVAL ." appears in uppercase serif-style lettering in a muted bronze-brown tone. Small solid heart-shaped bullet icons flank parts of the decorative separator areas visually, contributing to a romantic festive identity.

Below the English subtitle, aligned centrally under the large calligraphy, the primary informational message appears in clean bold black Chinese typeface: "月圆人团圆" followed directly underneath by "幸福共此时". Under these, a smaller body-message section begins after another subtle ornamental divider made of fine hairline rules and curled flourishes; the full body text as follows: "愿您在这个美好的节日里
与家人团聚，共享天伦之乐！" The surrounding sky includes multiple small glowing specks resembling fireflies or sparkling particles, plus several larger irregular white petal fragments that appear frozen midair and layered over the calligraphy.

On the right side of the upper-to-middle image, an enormous bright full moon occupies roughly one-fifth of the page width and glows with detailed crater textures, mottled gray-beige lunar maria, creamy highlights, and soft halos. Thin illuminated vapor trails curve near the moon and sweep through the mid-sky like stylized comet tails or silk ribbons catching sunlight. Several cylindrical paper lanterns float throughout the valley scene: some are fully visible as tan round lamps with dark ribs, caps, tassels, and warm internal flame points, while others recede into the distance as softer dots of golden light. The mid-background shows layered karst-like mountains and forested hills stretching toward a calm lake, with reflected moonlight forming a shimmering silver pathway across the water. Tiny boats, pagoda-roof structures, riverside architecture, tree clusters, and warmly lit windows populate the distant shore, all treated with painterly realism and atmospheric perspective.

In the right-middle-lower area, a red circular stamp illustration overlays the scenic background. It consists of concentric rings and sketchy hatch marks, containing a crescent moon graphic and handwritten-style Chinese text arranged in separate vertical columns from top to bottom. The visible inscription reads "花好月圆夜
岁岁年年情". A simple red outlined floral symbol sits within the lower part of the circle. The stamp is semi-transparent enough for the blue-gray environment behind it to show through, contrasting sharply with the warmer foreground food tones.

Near the central-left foreground, a long narrow rectangular hanging ornament descends from a rope loop tied to upright rustic wood bars or bamboo-like slats. The tag is matte beige paper with stitched border impressions, rounded clipped corners, and black Chinese calligraphy arranged vertically from top to bottom in columns, reading exactly "月满人间·千里婵娟". Its cord attachment rises out of frame or bends naturally above the tag, suggesting suspension from a canopy or outdoor structure. Wooden poles stand behind it at the far left and continue downward, adding architectural framing.

Across the lower-left corner, abundant blooming magnolia or plum blossoms cluster densely in shades of blush pink, coral, ivory, magenta, and violet, with glossy petals overlapping the basket edge and foreground tableware. These flowers create a lush botanical frame. In the lower foreground, several food vessels occupy the closest focal plane: a cream-speckled ceramic bowl filled with assorted glossy nuts, beans, seeds, dried fruits, raisins, and mixed ingredients spans much of the lower third; beside it, two large mooncakes rest on a wooden tray and cloth napkin. One intact mooncake sits on the left with deeply scored ridges and a scalloped shell in golden-brown baked dough; a second mooncake to the right is sliced open, showing a dense filling of reddish jujube dates embedded in sticky grain paste. Both cakes have the individual embossed Chinese character "福" pressed prominently into their tops. Crumbs scatter across the fabric and tabletop, emphasizing edible richness.

Behind and around the pastries are additional serving pieces: a patterned ceramic lidded pot or jar stands at the left-front edge with blue-green geometric bands and aged glazed texture; a small decorated porcelain cup contains hot milk tea or caramel drink in warm amber color; another steaming mug sits further back near the middle-right of the table emitting wisps of translucent steam; and a brass-toned or clay-textured metal container with handles anchors the far-right foreground. Leaning against the main dish is a rectangular folded paper menu or gift label, propped at an angle and colored warm tan with darker borders and shadowing. Its printed Chinese text is presented as stacked horizontal rows, visibly saying "团圆味
思念长
心自安". Small seed pods, walnuts, pine-nuts, almonds, grains, and dessert fragments lie scattered across the foreground, many intentionally blurred by shallow depth of field to reinforce macro photographic focus.

At the very bottom center of the poster, a fine ornamental divider frames three small gold-outlined hexagonal emblems representing good wishes and blessings, accompanied by accompanying text. Each emblem uses minimalist line art: the left hexagon contains a simplified person-and-heart gathering motif associated with companionship, the center hexagon depicts leaves or foliage for growth and appreciation, and the right hexagon resembles a lotus, mandala, or sunburst form conveying well-wishing, followed respectively by paired Chinese captions split by colon formatting: "珍惜相聚": "不负时光", "心怀感恩": "温暖前行", and "美好祝愿": "平安喜乐". Pale sepia line drawings of distant peaks decorate the lower margin as background patterns. The entire composition combines Chinese New Year-inspired calligraphy, Lunar-Festive symbolism such as mooncakes and lanterns, poetic reunion messaging referencing longing and peacefulness, fantasy-realistic food photography featuring specified dishes mentioning specific texts, and a rich blue-hour landscape with strong chiaroscuro, lens flares, volumetric glow, shallow-focus foreground blur, and warm golden highlights.
